Fox Valley Bicycle & Ski Club Sunday Intermediate Road Ride

Sugar Grove, IL · Road

Fox Valley Bicycle & Ski Club Sunday Intermediate Road Ride is a road group ride in Sugar Grove, IL. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Harter Middle School.

For visitors

Registration is required but free for everyone. Rear lights required; front light and bright clothing recommended. Riders may separate and regroup at turns. A faster Intermediate High group (18+ mph, listed separately) starts at the same time and doesn't wait.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15-16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Fox Valley Bicycle & Ski Club Sunday Intermediate Road Ride group ride

The club's Sunday intermediate road ride from Harter Middle School in Sugar Grove: 15 to 16 mph, no drop, regrouping at turns, with a meal afterward at a nearby restaurant.
